title: THE COMET'S SECOND TAIL
author: GPT

rounds.summary: The most formidable and genuinely alien counterpart of the ten (a field-shaped plasma ecology with no body and no language), a hard clock (three grain convoys in forty hours, five stations depending on them) and several parties with real vetoes (captains, station councils, prospectors with legal claims). Every ordinary fix fails for a stated physical or ethical reason (closing the corridor starves stations, the magnetic sweep sterilizes a nursery, rerouting exceeds radiation margins). The decisive observation (the knots avoid phase noise and follow coherent edges) is checkable from data, and the two-ribbon test can be dramatized as an experiment whose outcome Illuminara does not control.

Selected concept preserved (C03). Reframing adopted: the corridor's own guide rails are the lure, so the ecology is not an invader and a sweep or a re-route are both false binaries. Strongest rival (knots hunt beam energy) is tested by the beacon-nine clock gap. Load-bearing risk named in selection (obedient ecology) is attacked directly: the ecology declines both offered ribbons, chooses an unplanned seam that makes the lane worse, stretches and fails to keep pace when pulled too fast, and is met at its own pace. Illuminara states her own limit (reads field bending slightly ahead of instruments; cannot move knots), errs in public, and stops the slide at once. Dagny Voss keeps the key and the right to fire throughout; Farrant, Tadesse, Aydin and Achterberg each keep a veto or a cost. Positive result: all three convoys cross, the nursery is intact and relocated, the charter is rewritten around heartbeat-defined exclusion bands, shared beacons are funded. Remaining costs: two days' delay, Lamentine's mill cold for a day, one lost prospecting season south, a levy on haulers.

This is a vivid, disciplined first draft whose strongest move is that the ecology refuses both offered routes and discovers an unintended third edge. Illuminara reads a real anomaly, publishes a falsifiable prediction, admits when her test makes the lane worse, and then works inside a strict limit while Dagny Voss keeps the firing key. The distributed vetoes and visible costs earn the positive outcome. Before final, the draft should isolate the physical signal the knots actually follow, reconcile the mill-and-food timeline, and make Voss's stop/continue contract fully measurable after the heartbeat broadens.

Preserved the failed ninety-minute prediction, the ecology choosing the accidental seam, Illuminara admitting her error, bounded field-reading, Voss retaining the key, distributed vetoes, three-convoy success and the unresolved second tone. Revised only the causal discrimination, civic supply ledger and measurable post-deadline bargain requested by T02. Three bundled changes prevent causal attribution of any later quality difference to one intervention alone.

The revision does what T02 asked: the ecology still refuses both offered ribbons, a bounded control now separates phase coherence from strength, geometry and dust accumulation, the mill ledger is mostly auditable, and Voss and Aydin keep a measurable veto through the climax. The positive result is real and paid for. What remains is small but visible: a duplicated, partly contradictory Tadesse turn in the opening scene, one load-bearing step (the 'clock' that holds a coherent seam while it slides, and what keeps the braid there after Lamentine releases its array) that is asserted rather than shown, and a few mixed conventions in time and in Voss's definition of 'whole'. One further revision should be enough before a final.

Preserved the accidental third path, the failed prediction, Illuminara public admission of error, Achterberg rival hypothesis, Voss retaining the firing key, Farrant entering on her own judgement, Tadesse civic cost, the three-convoy success, seasonal extraction surrender and unresolved second tone. The revision changes only the three T04 points and their necessary continuity echoes.

What improves: all three convoys cross the lane before the six-week closure with nine hours to spare, the plasma nursery survives, the Lamentine mill restarts before its bread shelf is empty, and Pelion and Kestrel are resupplied before their seed stores open. For whom: Pelion and Kestrel first, the shells second, Lamentine's households and the Voss-Kane workforce third. Decisive contributions of Illuminara: she finds the forty-minute gap at Beacon Nine that overturns 'the knots hunt the beams', deduces that the guide rails were the attractor, writes a falsifiable prediction before the two ribbons go live, publicly accepts that it failed and that she had made the lane worse, converts the accidental seam into a controlled slide, and supplies the field-timing correction that the arrays cannot hold themselves, with a logged lead and a logged miss. Credible remaining cost: Lamentine's cold mill and fourteen hours of bread, a two-day convoy delay, Voss-Kane surrendering south-face extraction for a season, an unpaid levy for new beacons, and an unexplained second tone. Rule 3a is met; the result is real and paid for.

A comet's second tail turns out to be a nursery that follows the coherence of an edge, and one claim holder's firing key becomes the instrument that lets a mistake be found, admitted and repaired in time.
